title: Your Brain Hallucinates Your Conscious Reality | Anil Seth | TED
summary: Neuroscientist Anil Seth argues in this TED talk that perception is a controlled hallucination: the brain constantly predicts the world and our shared agreement is what we call reality. He also touches on the construction of the self.
why: HN cites it whenever threads touch consciousness, perception or predictive-processing, especially for its examples of expectation changing what you perceive.

quote.text: This TED talk has a great example where the same sound sounds different to you based on what you expect to hear
